Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Surprisingly, we were able to focus even better than usual!

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 出乎意料地，竟然比平时更能集中精神！

Data.UnitTalk_HIN: कम विज़िबिलिटी के कारण, ट्रेनिंग धीमी गति से चल रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 충분한 휴식을 취한 덕분에 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 기운이 넘쳐 보인다!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Thanks to a good rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looked to be full of energy again!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 十分な休息をとったおかげで、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は元気そうだ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 因为充分休息，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起来精力充沛！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 因為充分休息，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起來精力充沛！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Grâce à un repos suffisant, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semble en pleine forme !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Dank ausreichender Ruhe scheint <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> voller Energie zu sein!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Gracias al descanso suficiente, ¡<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece estar con mucha energía!
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Graças ao descanso suficiente, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece estar com muita energia!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ด้วยการพักผ่อนที่เพียงพอ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูมีชีวิตชีวามาก!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Berkat istirahat yang cukup, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampak bersemangat!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Nhờ được nghỉ ngơi đầy đủ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ tràn đầy năng lượng!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पर्याप्त आराम के कारण, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> बहुत उत्साहित लग रहा है!
